plain.li: The colony was underwater, and we all went on working, slower, with fish in the rafters.
In the dream every door led back into my own room. I opened eleven of them.
I could hear what the walls were thinking. They were worried about the roof.
The dream went on after I woke. For a while the floor kept rippling.
[child] I was a bird, and I could see the whole colony from up high.

warm.li: Everyone I've lost was sitting at our table, passing bread down the line.

gloomy.li: The sun didn't come up, and I was the only one who noticed.

cold.li: The fever produced another vivid dream. I'm keeping notes on them.

plain.li: I was drowning in a warm river, and someone kept pulling me up by the collar.
In the dream the doctor was counting the medicine, and every time there was one less.
My bed was a boat drifting away from shore, and the people on the bank were waving.

warm.li: My mother was wiping my forehead with a cool cloth. I woke up and it was the doctor.

gloomy.li: I saw my own grave, neat and well kept.

cold.li: A dream about dying. Not useful.
